name: Charts
summary: Bar, column, donut, line and sparkline charts in CSS and SVG, with no library.
description:
Use these for the handful of figures a marketing page or a small dashboard needs. For interactive analytics with tooltips and zoom, a chart library is the better tool.

Each chart can be read without seeing it. Bars are a real <table> with a bar drawn in each cell; columns are a list with each value in hidden text; the donut is an image whose name lists the shares, next to a legend that shows them; lines are inline SVG with a label. The server computes the values (percentages, SVG points); the CSS draws them. Series colours come from the kit's tokens, so they meet contrast in every direction and theme.
catalogue: Charts: sparkline, bar, line, area, donut

classes.name: v-chart
classes.description: The <figure> around any chart. Defines the series colours --v-chart-1 to --v-chart-5.

classes.name: v-chart-title
classes.description: The chart's <figcaption>.

classes.name: v-chart-bars
classes.description: A <table> of horizontal bars: a row header and a cell holding a .v-chart-track.

classes.name: v-chart-track
classes.description: The row of a bar and its value inside a table cell.

classes.name: v-chart-bar
classes.description: One bar. Set --v-value as a percentage of the largest value.

classes.name: v-chart-value
classes.description: The number after a bar.

classes.name: v-chart-columns
classes.description: A <ul role="list"> of vertical columns. --v-chart-height sets the height.

classes.name: v-chart-col
classes.description: One column, its height set by --v-value. Put the value in a .v-sr-only beside it.

classes.name: v-chart-label
classes.description: The label under a column, aria-hidden because the hidden text says it.

classes.name: v-donut
classes.description: A ring with role="img" and a label listing the shares. --v-donut takes a conic-gradient with cumulative stops; --v-donut-size its size.

classes.name: v-donut-total
classes.description: The figure in the middle of the ring, with an optional <small> line.

classes.name: v-sparkline
classes.description: A small inline <svg> with one <polyline>, for stat cards and table cells.

classes.name: v-chart-line
classes.description: A larger line chart <svg>, with optional .v-chart-grid lines and a .v-chart-area polygon.

classes.name: v-chart-area
classes.description: The tinted area under a line, on a <polygon>.

classes.name: v-chart-grid
classes.description: A guide line, on an SVG <line>.

classes.name: v-chart-legend
classes.description: A list of series names with their swatches and numbers.

classes.name: v-chart-swatch
classes.description: The colour key in a legend item, aria-hidden.

classes.name: v-chart-c2
classes.description: Series colour 2 on any bar, column, line or swatch. Also .v-chart-c3, .v-chart-c4 and .v-chart-c5.

classes.name: v-chart-c3
classes.description: Series colour 3.

classes.name: v-chart-c4
classes.description: Series colour 4.

classes.name: v-chart-c5
classes.description: Series colour 5, a neutral for "other".

states.description: On a bar or column: its size as a percentage of the chart's largest value.
On the donut: conic-gradient(var(--v-chart-1) 0 45%, var(--v-chart-2) 0 72%, ...): each stop is the running total.

a11y: Every chart carries its numbers in text: a table, hidden text in each column, a labelled image with a visible legend.
Colour is never the only key: the legend names each series next to its swatch and number.
SVG lines keep a 2px stroke however wide the chart is (vector-effect: non-scaling-stroke).
In forced colours the bars and swatches switch to the system text colour so they stay visible.
